title: test(cli): leave `field:` widget keys out of the namespaced refused-at-type count (objectui#12176)
body:
Fixes #12176
Clause-②: no

## What

`packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` counted every namespaced key of the generated `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` that `objectui validate` refuses at `type`, `field:` keys included. A `field:` key is a record-form field widget. It is selected through a field's `widget` (the spec resolves `FieldSchema.widget` as `field:` + widget) and never authored at a node's `type`, so no arm claims it. Every new field widget therefore forced a raise of `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE`, a pin whose own rule is that it never rises (first hit: objectui#12175, a named stopgap raise to 362).

As triage ruled (comment 6117438538, option (i) without the extra list):

- One predicate, `isFieldWidgetKey` (`key.startsWith('field:')`), reads the namespace from the key. It is used once, inside `namespacedPopulation(keys)`, and `NAMESPACED_POPULATION` is what the count row reads. No hand list of keys.
- `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` drops from 362 to 308, by the 54 `field:` keys on `main` `7e30d0b`. The docblock keeps the history trail in the file's own style: the objectui#7611 PR-5 raise stays recorded, and the objectui#12176 drop follows it.
- `NAMESPACED_KEYS` stays the full namespaced registration list. The batch-8 `field:${key}` assertions (`RETIRED_FIELD_FALLBACKS_10859_BATCH_8`) read it and are untouched.
- The stopgap `REFUSED_FIELD_WIDGET_KEYS_7611` constant and its row are removed: with the namespace out of the population, the raise it named is moot.
- Two pins, as triage words them:
  - "leaves a newly registered `field:` widget out of the count": a probe `field:no-such-widget-12176` goes through the same `namespacedPopulation` filter; it is refused at `type` (lit control), it is not in the population, and the refused set equals the head's.
  - "still counts a newly registered non-`field:` namespaced key with no arm — the control": a probe `view:no-such-view-12176` through the same filter is exactly one more refused key, appended to the head's set.
- The namespaced non-vacuity row also reads the counted population now: a floor of 300 on `NAMESPACED_POPULATION`, and `ui:calendar` as its lit control. The floor of 350 on `NAMESPACED_KEYS` stays.
- `REFUSED_AT_TYPE = 0` (the bare half) is untouched.
- `.changeset/12176-ratchet-field-namespace.md` has an empty frontmatter: `check-changeset-presence` counts any file under a released package's `src/`, tests included, and asked for one.

## Premise check (dispatch hypotheses, measured on `7e30d0b`)

- H1: `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` carries 393 namespaced keys, 54 of them `field:`. All 54 are refused at `type` (none armed). There are 362 refused namespaced keys in all, 308 of them outside `field:`. A throwaway probe test measured this and was deleted before the first commit.
- H2: the "Named so the raise ... says which keys it covers" block is the `REFUSED_FIELD_WIDGET_KEYS_7611` docblock. It is removed, and its history is in the pin's comment trail.
- H3: the bare side's probe pattern (`[...BARE_KEYS, probe].filter(refusedAtType)`) is mirrored. The probe goes through the population FILTER, not past it, because the namespaced pins exist to test that filter.
- H4: the batch-8 `field:${key}` assertions read `NAMESPACED_KEYS`. On `main` that same constant was also the counted population, so narrowing `NAMESPACED_KEYS` itself would have turned them red. The registration list and the counted population are therefore two names now, and the batch-8 rows read the first exactly as before.

## Tests (final head `c321560`)

- The ratchet file: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` gives 33 passed (32 on `main`: one row removed, two added).
- The whole package: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/cli/` gives `Test Files 26 passed (26)`, `Tests 385 passed (385)`, run at `c321560`.
- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` echoes `tsc --noEmit` and exits 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/cli^...'` (8 of 8 cached). `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` lists the ratchet test file, so the package's `src/**/*` include covers it.

## Ablations (each committed first; the test file blob is `d66a2c0184d5` at both `fbe371a` and `c321560`)

Every mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 time, blob changed on disk). Every restore was checked the same way: blob equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

1. Exclusion reverted (`namespacedPopulation` filters on `key.includes(':')` alone): 2 failed, 31 passed. The count row fails with `expected 362 to be 308`, and the `field:` probe pin fails with the probe included.
2. Exclusion widened to `view:` as well: 2 failed, 31 passed. The count row fails with `expected 288 to be 308`, and the control fails.
3. The same widening, with the pin lowered to 288 as the count row's own message tells an author to do: 1 failed, 32 passed. Only the control fails. This is the case the control exists for, because the count row cannot see a widened exclusion once the pin is lowered to match.

## Gates (run at `c321560`, exit codes captured before any pipe)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 0. It was 1 before the changeset ("1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset"), and now reads "declares 1 changeset(s) ... EMPTY frontmatter".
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 ("0 new citation(s)"). `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: all 0.
- `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit` and `check-shell-escape-residue`: all 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed to the one changed source file, and stated as a measurement with three pieces of evidence:
  - population: `eslint --print-config` on the file puts 118 rules in effect, `object-ui/no-line-address-in-test-name` among them;
  - count: `--format json` reports 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings;
  - invariance: the resolved config has no `parserOptions` (no type-aware linting), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Boundary, recorded and not filed: the predicate reads the namespace from the key's first segment. The 38 `protocol-placeholder:field:*` keys are the opt-in `PROTOCOL_COMPONENTS` placeholders that `@object-ui/components` registers under the `protocol-placeholder` namespace, and they stay in the population. They come from a constant list in that file and do not grow when a field widget registers, so they do not reproduce this card's defect. The predicate's docblock says so.
- The pin's history line says "fifty-four on `main` at the time". That is a dated reading, marked as one, in the file's existing style. The live count is the one the count row re-derives.
